title: Project rules
description: Optional rules for this project. Each one only limits what can be done from now on; nothing that exists is changed.
loadFailed: The rules could not be loaded.
singleProject: A task can belong to only one project
singleProjectHelp: Tasks of this project cannot also be placed in other projects, and tasks from other projects cannot be added to it. Moving a task to another project is still possible.
lockMoves: Tasks cannot be moved to or from this project
lockMovesHelp: Nobody can move a task into this project from another one, or out of it into another one.
